title: BundlerMD Project
description: A BundlerMD project file (.bmd). Stores the file list, settings, and last export path for a bundle.

files.description: Paths of the files in the bundle, in workarea order. Files under the project file's directory are stored relative to it (forward-slashed); files elsewhere are absolute.

last_export.description: Absolute path of the last exported bundle file, or null.

include_description_in_export.description: Whether the description text is emitted after the title and before the Table of Contents.

newlines.description: Output newline style: unix (LF), windows (CRLF), or platform default.

path_presentation.description: How file paths are stored in this file and rendered in the bundle's TOC and section headers. 'smart' stores/shows files under the project directory relative to it and others absolute; 'absolute' always uses full paths.

toc_links.description: Whether TOC entries link to their sections via GitHub-style anchors.
